method.units: bytes for JS heap; counts for DOM metrics
method.gc: Each observation waits 30 ms, forces HeapProfiler.collectGarbage, then reads Performance metrics and Memory.getDOMCounters.
method.final: After five alive apps are destroyed and asset cache cleared, waits 5.5 s before final GC measurement and full heap snapshot.
method.core: Memory run core stage includes the common benchmark harness; this differs from the separate core-load fixture.
limitations: One complete memory round per framework at each cycle count; these are paired diagnostic observations, not estimated population means or significance tests.
Each sequence contains both N same-assets and N unique-assets cycles plus initial and alive app work; N is not the total mount count.
GC heap is not browser RSS; V8 table self_size is not retained size.
The final five-app stage may set the same backing-table high-water mark for N=30 and N=100.
Before/candidate differences also contain ordinary JIT and measurement variation; the explicit heap binding audit separately verifies the target allocation change.
load-initial preserves the first candidate-vs-Wujie load run; it is not the later before/candidate A/B run.
